recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source edit is needed for FHIR-32804; if the SVG is still used in publication output, regenerate or review diagram artifacts separately.
issue_request: FHIR-32804 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request to add a 0..1 dateTime recorded element to MedicationDispense for identifying when dispense activity began when whenPrepared or whenHandedOver is not populated.
initial_application: Commit 6cdd7b792e2241b7191584bd35915d4b0f9841f8 added MedicationDispense.recorded to source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml and added a recorded date search parameter to source/medicationdispense/bundle-MedicationDispense-search-params.xml.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied/Persuasive issue FHIR-40808 found the original if-whenPrepared/whenHandedOver wording misleading and changed the authoritative StructureDefinition definition to say the date the occurrence of the MedicationDispense was first captured in the system. The old original wording remains only in source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense.svg, a generated-looking diagram artifact.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active XML source already contains the requested element, cardinality, type, and related search parameter, and because the current definition reflects the later approved clarification rather than an unapplied FHIR-32804 gap.

related_jiras.note: Companion Pharmacy issue added MedicationDispense.statusChanged in the same source commit and meeting, but it is a separate timing element and was not decided here.
Later Pharmacy issue clarified the wording of MedicationDispense.recorded while preserving the element added for FHIR-32804; it already has its own combined-branch audit commit.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue requiring a 0..1 dateTime MedicationDispense.recorded element.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request and confirms the issue is final and in scope for audit reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationDispense is active in fhir.ini and the StructureDefinition contains MedicationDispense.recorded as a 0..1 dateTime element.
evidence_items.learned: The active authoritative source already implements the requested element and cardinality.

evidence_items.summary: The MedicationDispense search parameter bundle includes the recorded date search parameter over MedicationDispense.recorded.
evidence_items.learned: The source application included the search surface that was added with the element.

evidence_items.summary: The FHIR-32804 commit added MedicationDispense.recorded to the StructureDefinition and a recorded date search parameter.
evidence_items.learned: The requested source change was previously applied before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Later Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy issue changed MedicationDispense.recorded to the first-captured-in-system definition.
evidence_items.learned: The current definition's difference from the original FHIR-32804 wording is intentional and should not be reverted.

evidence_items.summary: Pharmacy minutes record FHIR-32804 carried 6-0-0 with a motion to add recorded date to MedicationDispense.
evidence_items.learned: This corroborates the Jira vote and source application scope.

evidence_items.locator: Source, Zulip, and Confluence searches for FHIR-32804 MedicationDispense.recorded
evidence_items.command: rg -n 'The date (and maybe time) when the dispense activity started|whenPrepared or whenHandedOver|The date the occurrence of the MedicationDispense' source/medicationdispense; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-32804; bun run zulip:search sql "SELECT ... WHERE content LIKE '%FHIR-32804%' OR content LIKE '%MedicationDispense.recorded%'"
evidence_items.summary: The old wording appears only in medicationdispense.svg; Confluence confirms the Pharmacy vote, and Zulip had no relevant conflicting discussion beyond an unrelated dependency-link hit.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered evidence justifies a source change when the active XML source is already correct.
